title: Deploy self-hosted Langfuse for coding-agent tracing and evaluation
body:
Parent: #125. Phase P1. Depends on #128.

## Decision
**Langfuse is the selected observability platform** (2026-10-29), aligned with prospective adoption at work. This issue replaces the earlier Phoenix-vs-Langfuse comparison/pilot. Do **not** build a Phoenix integration or undertake a broad vendor selection exercise. Keep the OTLP instrumentation boundary vendor-neutral (#128).

## Scope
- Deploy current supported Langfuse self-hosted stack locally with Podman-compatible Compose (or document validated alternative), **no GitHub Actions compute**.
- Inventory runtime components and resource use (Langfuse web/worker, database, ClickHouse, Redis and object storage where required by the chosen version); plan volumes, backups/restore, upgrades and explicit sizing for the available hardware.
- Configure OTLP traces ingestion/authentication, network/TLS/access permissions, credentials/secrets handling and bounded retention. Confirm exact endpoint and supported version from Langfuse documentation rather than hardcoding stale defaults.
- Support traces across scheduler, agent CLI wrappers, distributed workers and unified verification, correlating run/attempt/issue IDs from #126/#128.
- Add privacy-safe metadata and redaction before ingestion; do not persist raw secrets, unapproved prompts, full source files or unrestricted command output.
- Connect stable trace URLs/IDs back to Cezar run explorer (#135); use Langfuse UI for trace waterfall rather than reproducing it in Cezar.
- Prepare a small evaluation experiment fixture for later #137, without introducing learned routing now.
- Document health checks, backup/recovery, failure modes, safe degradation when Langfuse is unavailable, and explicit artifact/audit separation (#127/#130).

## Acceptance
- [ ] Supported self-hosted Langfuse starts, survives restart and has documented deployment/maintenance steps.
- [ ] Synthetic and real coding run spans ingest through OpenTelemetry, including multi-machine correlation.
- [ ] Run/attempt/issue IDs navigate from Cezar to the correct Langfuse trace.
- [ ] No traces contain test secrets or unauthorized prompt/source content.
- [ ] When Langfuse is offline, coding execution and authoritative audit events continue; telemetry loss is surfaced.
- [ ] Resource usage, retention, backup/restore and access controls are documented and tested.

## Related
#125 #126 #127 #128 #130 #135 #137. Existing #94 owns routing/quota event semantics.
